phases.name: r0-swarm
phases.description: R0.7 live e2e: two Pi seats settle one trivial committed change, closed by the lead.
phases.objective: You are the lead seat of rig r0-e2e, working in the current directory (a git repo). 1. Create r0_swarm_e2e_marker.py containing exactly one function: def marker() -> int: return 42. 2. Delegate to the worker seat named 'worker' (message it with rig send): the worker must create r0_swarm_e2e_marker_test.py that imports marker from r0_swarm_e2e_marker, asserts marker() == 42, and prints marker-test-passed. 3. When the worker's file exists, run: python3 r0_swarm_e2e_marker_test.py — it must print marker-test-passed and exit 0. 4. git add r0_swarm_e2e_marker.py r0_swarm_e2e_marker_test.py and commit BOTH on the CURRENT branch (do not create a new branch). 5. Then close your queue item as done with no follow-on. Do not start any new work after closing.
